title: Access reviews
lead: Organizations whose last owner asked to close them, or that have no active owner left. Oldest first; dates are in Yerevan time. Nothing tells the owner the outcome, so tell them yourself.
nameUnread: Its name couldn’t be read, so its reference is shown.

reason.LAST_OWNER_CLOSURE: Its last owner asked to close it.
reason.INACTIVE_OWNER_RECOVERY: Its owner’s account was closed, so it has no active owner.

HANDOVER.title: Hand {{name}} to another member?
HANDOVER.body: The member you choose becomes an owner. Nobody else’s access changes.

CLOSE.title: Close {{name}}?
CLOSE.body: Nothing reopens it. Its events and payment history stay, but its members, invitations and unfinished work go, and nobody can open its events.

DECLINE.title: Decline the review of {{name}}?
DECLINE.body: Nothing changes in the organization, and the review is closed.

handover.label: Who becomes an owner
handover.unread: Its members couldn’t be read. Close this and try again.
handover.none: It has no member who could own it. Close it or decline instead.
handover.stopped: Only the first 200 members are listed.

close.typeLabel: Type the organization’s name to confirm
close.typeReference: Type the organization’s reference, as shown above, to confirm

refusal.forbidden: This page is for Aveline’s administrators.
refusal.moved: This review has moved on since the page was read, perhaps by someone else. It has been read again.
refusal.successor: That member can’t become an owner: they may have left, or their account was closed. Choose another.
refusal.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Please wait a moment and try again.
refusal.noAnswer: We didn’t get an answer, so it may have happened. Read the page again before trying again.
